package.name: helix_supervisor_cpp
package.description: HELIX supervisor: one C++ fault-state machine that replaces the Python HeartbeatMonitor, DiagnosisNode and RecoveryNode. Tracks faults until they are cleared by evidence, seeds expected heartbeats so a node that never starts is a fault, and publishes the /helix/hold state the motion arbiter consumes, with arbiter and robot-controller acknowledgments.
